sdc.daemon.ConfinementLevel.title: ConfinementLevel
sdc.daemon.ConfinementLevel.description: How strongly a run is sandboxed, weakest first: the runtime's names. local is not confined; linux is. oci and pod are the runtime's planned levels and are not in the set until it offers them. A submit that names no level runs at the daemon's default level (runbook serve --default-confinement, or `confinement` of runbook.toml), else at linux; the handler fills it. The daemon's floor is linux unless it is started lower; the default is never below the floor, and a daemon whose default is below its floor does not start. local must be asked for by name or set as the default, and is refused under a linux floor.

sdc.daemon.DaemonId.title: DaemonId
sdc.daemon.DaemonId.description: The id of the one daemon the specification describes: the configuration row it holds is keyed by it. The HTTP handler fills it; one process is one daemon.
